about: (Noah) the hidden quests, BO3-style: one for each city's Echo Altar, begun once the city is freed and never explained in game (the altar's menu shows its whispers, a line more for each step found; the Codex keeps the first). Steps: touch (find n glowing things round the altar, element in hand if asked, at night if night, without being hurt if nodamage, within seconds if set), order (touch n stones in the order they light), altar (return to the altar), kills (n of the night's dead on marked ground), survive (n of the dead risen round the altar; dark: the screen darkens), boss (a named foe: an enemies row). rewards: summon (plugin|id|count: a lesser power that calls them for the night, one summon out at a time) - every quest its own (Noah: summons, not permanent buffs); buff and spell are still understood.

rows.title: The Sleeping Giant's Toast
rows.rewardText: The Sleeping Giant: a giant wakes and fights beside you for the night.
hints: The Giant sleeps, but his cups are scattered about the village after dark.
Three cups, and an altar thirsty for a toast.
Drunk dead don't stay down for long.

steps.text: Find the three glowing mead-cups hidden around Riverwood at night
steps.name: mead-cup

steps.text: Raise the toast at the Echo Altar
steps.name: the altar

steps.text: Survive the drunken dead

rows.title: Sap of the Gildergreen
rows.rewardText: The Gildergreen's Guardian: a spriggan answers your call and mends your wounds.
hints: The Gildergreen weeps golden sap - but only flame will loosen it.
Bring what the tree gave you to the altar.
Kynareth's tree is jealous of its gifts.

steps.text: Burn loose the four drops of golden sap (a fire spell or the fire bow in hand)
steps.name: drop of sap

steps.text: Pour the sap on the Echo Altar
steps.name: the altar

steps.text: Hold the altar while the sap takes

rows.title: The Wolf Queen's Court
rows.rewardText: The Wolf Queen's Pack: three spectral wolves answer your call.
hints: Her braziers remember the order she lit them in.
Watch which flame wakes first.
Her court is fed with the dead.

steps.text: Light the Wolf Queen's three braziers in the order they flicker
steps.name: brazier

steps.text: Feed her court: kill 25 of the dead on the marked ground
steps.name: the marked ground

rows.title: Ysgramor's Horn
rows.rewardText: A Shield-Brother of Ysgramor: a spectral warrior answers your call.
hints: Five horns lie frozen in the ice around the city.
Ice yields to cold harder still.
Sound the horn and his brothers come - to test you.

steps.text: Shatter the five frozen horns with frost
steps.name: frozen horn

steps.text: Sound the horn at the Echo Altar
steps.name: the altar

steps.text: Prove yourself to Ysgramor's brothers

rows.title: The Resonance
rows.rewardText: The Centurion's Oath: a Dwemer Centurion answers your call.
hints: Four resonators hum beneath the stone city's shadow.
Strike them as they sing - high to low, as they show you.
What the Dwemer built still guards what they left.

steps.text: Strike the four resonators in the order they sing
steps.name: resonator

steps.text: Destroy the Centurion the resonance woke
steps.name: The Resonant Centurion

rows.title: The Nightingale's Debt
rows.rewardText: The Nightingale's Due: two Nightingale agents step out of the shadows to fight for you.
hints: Three shadow coins, taken by night.
A Nightingale is never touched. Bleed, and the coins slip away.
Pay the debt in darkness.

steps.text: Take the three shadow coins at night without being hurt
steps.name: shadow coin

steps.text: Pay the debt at the Echo Altar
steps.name: the altar

steps.text: Survive the dark

rows.title: Arkay's Last Rites
rows.rewardText: Arkay's Honoured Dead: two spirits of the honoured dead rise to fight for you.
hints: Six graves cry out to be fed.
The ground near the altar is hungry for the night's dead.
A fallen priest still keeps the rites.

steps.text: Feed the graves: kill 30 of the dead on the hallowed ground
steps.name: the marked ground

steps.text: Ring the rites at the Echo Altar at midnight
steps.name: the altar

steps.text: Lay the Fallen Priest to rest
steps.name: The Fallen Priest of Arkay

rows.title: Lanterns of the Drowned
rows.rewardText: A Will-o'-the-Wisp answers your call and shocks the dead near you.
hints: Lanterns burn in the marsh - but not for long.
Five, before the last light dies.
The drowned sing when the lanterns are lit.

steps.text: Light the five marsh lanterns within a minute
steps.name: lantern

steps.text: Silence the Drowned Skald
steps.name: The Drowned Skald

rows.title: Vaermina's Dream
rows.rewardText: Vaermina's Servant: a Dremora Lord steps out of her dream to fight for you.
hints: Shards of a nightmare litter the cold shore.
Rest at the altar and dream.
In her dream, nothing is seen until it is close.

steps.text: Gather three nightmare shards
steps.name: nightmare shard

steps.text: Dream at the Echo Altar
steps.name: the altar

steps.text: Wake from the nightmare

rows.title: The Eye's Reflection
rows.rewardText: The Eye's Reflection: a magic anomaly answers your call and burns the dead with the Eye's light.
hints: Four anomalies drift at the cliff's edge.
Turn the College's light upon the altar - in the order it shows.
The Eye guards its light.

steps.text: Gather the four floating anomalies
steps.name: anomaly

steps.text: Turn the four light-stones in the order they shine
steps.name: light-stone

steps.text: Unmake the Great Anomaly
steps.name: The Great Anomaly
